name: site-call-button
title: Call Button
description: A floating contact card at the bottom corner of every page: call by phone (a tel: link) or write on WhatsApp, Signal or Telegram, plain links that ask nothing of any host before a click; it waits while the cookie banner is up and the page scrolls clear of it; two layouts (card, bar), colours, fonts and radius from the project's design system

layouts.title: Card
layouts.description: A floating card at the bottom corner (end side), the optional title above the links stacked, the first link primary; the default.

layouts.title: Bar
layouts.description: On a phone a full-width bar along the bottom edge, the links side by side in equal columns; from md the card.

proof: installs alone on Next 16; two layouts (card, bar); the footer's last line never under it; hidden while the consent banner is up; 3 sample brands, light and dark, 390/768/1280 px, 2 hosts; axe clean
postMessage: See components/site-call-button/README.md for the layouts, where to place it (last in body, after your footer), the phone and messenger links, the labels (German included) and the design tokens it reads.
